question: Let $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ be defined as follows: $f(x)=\begin{cases}x,&x\ge0\\0,&x<0\end{cases}$ and $g(x)=\begin{cases}x^2,&x\ge0\\0,&x<0\end{cases}$. Then

options.B: $f$ is differentiable at $x=0$ but $g$ is not
options.C: $g$ is differentiable at $x=0$ but $f$ is not
